claims.head: Tampa Bay’s shot volume meets a soft spot
claims.body: Tampa Bay ranks 4th of 32 for shot volume (64.9 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Seattle ranks 32nd of 32 for shot suppression.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season

check.measure: 5-on-5 shot attempts per 60, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Tampa Bay will try to get Kucherov, Point, Goncalves out against Gaudreau, Winterton, Meyers
claims.body: At home, Tampa Bay’s L2 (Kucherov, Point, Goncalves) has spent 53% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ fourth lines. With no line matching it would be about 25%. Tonight Seattle’s usual fourth line is Gaudreau, Winterton, Meyers.
claims.cite: Who plays against whom · Tampa Bay home games this season · 3 games, 31 minutes for this group at 5-on-5

check.measure: share of Tampa Bay L2's 5-on-5 time against Seattle L4
check.rule: held if the share is at or above the home habit; partly if above the no-matching level; otherwise didn't happen
